name: my-way-of-evangelism
description: Cloudflare Worker static assets project for My Way of Evangelism church discovery and digital evangelism platform.

scripts.check: node --check src/worker.js && node --check public/app.js && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply my-way-of-evangelism-preview --local --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply my-way-of-evangelism-preview --remote --env preview
